ar.title: كوكو البطاطس الفارسي

steps.n1: تُقشر البطاطس وتُسلق، ثم تُهرس في وعاء عميق.
steps.n2: يُخلط فيها البيض والبصل والكركم والملح والفلفل حتى يصبح ناعماً.
steps.n3: يُسخن سمن ويُقلى الخليط كعجة سميكة، يُرفع الطرف مع تماسك القاع لينسكب البيض النيء تحته.
steps.n4: يُقلب ويُقلى حتى يصبح بنياً من الجانبين.
steps.n6: فطائر: انثر ملاعق من الخليط في سمن ساخن، اضغطها وقليها بعمق، ثم صفها على ورق ماص.

en.title: Persian Potato Kuku or Patties (Kuku-ye Sibzamini)
en.intro: Recipe 72, page 33 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash them in a deep bowl.
steps.n2: Mix in the eggs, onion, turmeric, salt and pepper until smooth.
steps.n3: Heat ghee and fry the mixture like a thick omelet, lifting the edge as the bottom sets so the uncooked egg runs underneath.
steps.n4: Turn it over and fry until brown on both sides.
steps.n5: Cut into thick wedges and serve.
steps.n6: Patties: drop spoonfuls of the mixture into hot ghee, flatten them and deep-fry, then drain on absorbent paper.

legacySteps: Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash them in a deep bowl.
Mix in the eggs, onion, turmeric, salt and pepper until smooth.
Heat ghee and fry the mixture like a thick omelet, lifting the edge as the bottom sets so the uncooked egg runs underneath.
Turn it over and fry until brown on both sides.
Cut into thick wedges and serve.
Patties: drop spoonfuls of the mixture into hot ghee, flatten them and deep-fry, then drain on absorbent paper.
